name: How To Train Your Children
overview: Scripture teaches that training children is a sacred responsibility entrusted to parents, emphasizing consistent and intentional instruction throughout daily life, as seen in Deuteronomy 11:19 and Psalms 78:5. Children are described as a heritage from the Lord, underscoring their value and the importance of nurturing them in His ways (Psalms 127:3). Biblical wisdom advocates for loving discipline, including timely correction to guide children away from folly (Proverbs 13:24; 22:15), while Proverbs 22:6 highlights that early, purposeful training shapes their lifelong path.
